import importlib.util, pathlib, textwrap
base=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u093/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    fixed = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2}
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or color == 2 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            objects.append((color, cells))
    occupied = set(fixed)
    placed = []
    for color, cells in sorted(objects, key=lambda obj: max(y for y,x in obj[1]), reverse=True):
        delta = 0
        while all(y+delta+1 < h and (y+delta+1,x) not in occupied for y,x in cells):
            delta += 1
        moved = [(y+delta,x) for y,x in cells]
        occupied.update(moved)
        placed.extend((y,x,color) for y,x in moved)
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in fixed:
        out[r][c] = 2
    for r,c,color in placed:
        out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
